address: Colwell Chine Road, Colwell Bay, Freshwater, PO40 9NP, United Kingdom
bio: This elegant restaurant is superbly set amongst colourful beach huts and looks out over the sea to Hurst Castle. Sit on one of the terraces or under retractable roofs and enjoy anything from fish tacos to a fruits de mer platter. Most diners arrive by boat (they’ll even collect you from your mooring)....
